answer: Require each agent to earn its voting weight through a falcon-like watch: a single, non-transferable work record built from sequential, time-locked tasks that cannot be run in parallel. Like a tide that only rises once, progress is checked at unpredictable intervals, and each step is sealed with a cipher tied to the agent's prior work. A newcomer starts with no weight and gains it slowly, so creating a thousand fake identities means paying a thousand slow, separate histories, while honest agents pay the cost only once.
